what: Clicking a link to another page of the same site makes a curtain whose bottom edge is a round-headed ruffle (8 widths on wide screens, 4 on narrow, depth .3 of the width · oscillating ±.4 for 1.75 cycles, each width .12 later) rise from below in .6s with the ”main” curve (0.625,0.05,0,1) and cover the screen. Once the curtain passes halfway, a center token (a gold coin) pops out from 0 → 1x with back.out(2.6) in .45s, stays .3s, then moves on. On the arrival page, the sagging ruffle hem lifts away upward in .8s with the same curve. If the middle of the screen is a photo or video at click time, it is covered with a light panel

options.dur: Cover duration (s), default .6 — 0 moves on immediately
options.hold: Hold time after the marker lands (sec), default .3
options.pop: Duration the ticket pops out (sec), default .45
options.folds: Number of pleats on wide screens (992px and up), default 8
options.[data-fx-part=badge]: Mark that pops out in the middle of the curtain (logo, gold coin). Optional
options.[data-curtain-skip]: Links inside this go through with no curtain

from.where: shared.js PP.cover·PP.uncover (blocks the barba transition) — original barba curtain: in .6 main · coin back.out(2.6) .45 · hold .3 · out .8 main · fold 8/4 · pink panel when over a photo

note: The original keeps the header with barba and swaps only the body, but the part intercepts links and covers the page so it attaches to any site, then hands off to a normal navigation, and the arriving page reads a sessionStorage flag and reveals itself. When returning with the back button (bfcache), the cover is removed.
